snacs_adaptation_notes.txt:
SNACS v2.6 annotation notes from authorized guidelines and purchased review examples. Each target receives [scene role, lexical function], with p. prefixes. Scene role reflects the relation in context; lexical function reflects the adposition/possessive's conventional meaning. Preserve divergent role/function construals.

Movement and location: 'went to the school' where school is an institution attended: [p.Org,p.Goal] (reviews-247226-0002); 'went to my PA' and 'gone to a heart surgeon': [p.Goal,p.Goal] (reviews-148971-0015). 'Pedicures at Lovely Nails', 'Lovely Nails on Military Road', and 'driving on highway': [p.Locus,p.Locus] (reviews-128168-0002, reviews-349020-0003). Even typo 'go the the bus boys station' has second 'the' annotated [p.Goal,p.Goal] (reviews-010433-0005). 'Far from perfect': [p.Source,p.Source] (reviews-290594-0013). 'All over my hair': [p.Locus,p.Locus] (reviews-018465-0008).

Possessives/genitives: Owned money, car, dog, or hooptie: [p.Possessor,p.Possessor] (reviews-165143-0006, reviews-295288-0006, reviews-290594-0013, reviews-389498-0001). Agentive possessive 'your contributions' or 'her help': [p.Agent,p.Gestalt] (reviews-080221-0004, reviews-062167-0005). Body part 'my hair' and car parts 'car's gears and brakes': [p.Whole,p.Gestalt] (reviews-018465-0008, reviews-295288-0006). 'My PA' (provider/patient relation): [p.SocialRel,p.Gestalt] (reviews-148971-0015). 'Bus boy's station' for the worker's use: [p.Beneficiary,p.Possessor] (reviews-010433-0005).

Quantities and partitives: 'Each of you' and 'one of them': [p.QuantityItem,p.Whole] (reviews-080221-0004, reviews-290594-0013). 'Plenty of options': [p.QuantityItem,p.QuantityItem] (reviews-121342-0003).

Emotion and evaluation: 'Proud of your contributions' and 'pleased with that one': [p.Stimulus,p.Topic] (reviews-080221-0004, reviews-255261-0008). 'Important to them': [p.Experiencer,p.Goal] (reviews-122270-0004). 'Much for daycare' in 'a little much for daycare': [p.ComparisonRef,p.Purpose] (reviews-290594-0013).

Purpose, beneficiary, means: 'Start out by saying': [p.Means,p.Means] (reviews-128168-0002). 'Things for earrings' (making earrings), 'to get napkins', 'made to suit me': [p.Purpose,p.Purpose] (reviews-377347-0004, reviews-010433-0005, reviews-122270-0004). 'Options for picky eaters' and 'do nothing for you': [p.Beneficiary,p.Beneficiary] (reviews-121342-0003, reviews-148971-0015).

Other constructions: 'Walk out with crap all over my hair': with=[p.Characteristic,p.Characteristic] (reviews-018465-0008). 'A great job of taking care of ...': of=[p.Identity,p.Identity]; 'maintenance on my hooptie': on=[p.Theme,p.Theme] (reviews-389498-0001). 'Throughout the year': [p.Duration,p.Duration] (reviews-080221-0004). 'At least': [p.Extent,p.Extent] (reviews-290594-0013). 'A heart surgeon like him': [p.Identity,p.ComparisonRef] (reviews-148971-0015); 'it's like driving a new car': [p.ComparisonRef,p.ComparisonRef] (reviews-295288-0006).
